_comment: Baseline for the in-context ARC programme (2026-10-21, docs/claude_2026-10-21_prior_universality.md section 6): the current LT unchanged (bands, as configs/arc1_bands.json) on data/arc_ctx15.npz, i.e. ARC tasks whose grids all have sides <= 15, demonstrations in context and no task identifiers (no puzzle embedding, no prefix), Fast FFN off, rule_syn off. Training pool: ARC-AGI-1 training + new ARC-AGI-2 training tasks (355); evaluation: the unseen ARC-AGI-1 evaluation tasks (189 tasks, 207 test pairs). An episode stacks 5 demonstration slots and the query as 12 canvases of 16x16 (3,072 cells); the loss covers the query output's cells and EOS row/column. Episodes drawn on the fly: query = a random pair of the task, demonstrations = up to 5 of the others, one dihedral transform and one permutation of all 10 colors per episode.
